targets.rawSql: SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'redis.clients.connected' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) / 1048576, 2) AS value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'redis.memory.used' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) / 1048576, 2) AS value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'redis.memory.rss' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix), 2) AS value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'redis.memory.fragmentation_ratio' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'redis.keyspace.hits' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'redis.db.keys' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.memory.used') / 1048576, 2) AS used_mb, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.memory.rss') / 1048576, 2) AS rss_mb, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.memory.peak') / 1048576, 2) AS peak_mb FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('redis.memory.used','redis.memory.rss','redis.memory.peak') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round((max(Value) - min(Value)) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0), 2) AS commands_per_sec FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'redis.commands.processed' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round((maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keyspace.hits') - minIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keyspace.hits')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0), 2) AS hits_per_sec, round((maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keyspace.misses') - minIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keyspace.misses')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0), 2) AS misses_per_sec FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('redis.keyspace.hits','redis.keyspace.misses') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round((maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.net.input') - minIf(Value, MetricName='redis.net.input')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0) / 1024, 2) AS net_input_kbps, round((maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.net.output') - minIf(Value, MetricName='redis.net.output')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0) / 1024, 2) AS net_output_kbps FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('redis.net.input','redis.net.output') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, round((maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keys.evicted') - minIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keys.evicted')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0), 4) AS evicted_per_sec, round((maxIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keys.expired') - minIf(Value, MetricName='redis.keys.expired')) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0), 4) AS expired_per_sec FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('redis.keys.evicted','redis.keys.expired') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) AS time, max(Value) AS connected_clients FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'redis.clients.connected' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
